preset.header: Are you ready for the tutorial?
preset.text: Once enough people click Ready, the tutorial will start!

preset.question: You can always see the contact in the spot with your name on it!

preset.text: Secretly look at any contact. You can always look at this contact again by clicking the eyeball icon on that spot.
Swap YOUR contact with another contact in the center that is still face down.
Flip over YOUR contact and use their power.
These 3 contacts appear in all 3 colors.

Immediately end the round. You can only take this action on someone else’s turn.

You have 7 seconds to play this card at the start of someone else’s turn. If multiple players try to end the round at the same time, the player closest to the current player in the turn order gets to end the round.
You will click on 3 contacts in the center, and they will get flipped over. All 3 need to match your color for you to win the round - talk to the other players, but be wary of their intentions!

If you are successful and all 3 contacts that you flipped match your team’s color, you get 2 points for winning the round, and any other players on your team get 1 point.

If you’re unsuccessful, your team loses, and every player on a different team gets 1 point.
